next.reason: 1985: "The ADVANCING phrase allows control of the vertical positioning of each message or message segment on a communication device"; 2023: "SEND has no ADVANCING phrase: "A message is sent to the run unit identified by the content of literal-1 or message-server-name-1."". The 2023 SEND sends messages to a message server run unit and has no ADVANCING phrase; the 1985 communication-device SEND is gone. The DISPLAY and WRITE rules cover other statements.
